assumptions.statement: Official regulatory-plan controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, rail/blue lines, and engineering constraints are not public; all such conclusions are to-be-confirmed and must be validated from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: FAR, building height, road redlines, heritage control lines, and engineering conclusions are recorded as unknown or to-be-confirmed; the package remains reviewable as a formal AI submission for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional (PROV-SITE-001, PROV-KEY-001/002/003) derived from the official announcement's textual extents and areas; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, and figures are intake/visualization values; once official polygons are published, every geometry layer and metric must be recomputed and this package regenerated.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partition, building blocks, roads, green space, public space, and phasing are concept design layers generated by the agent from the provisional boundary; adjacent polygons share exact boundary coordinates and coverage is gap-free by construction.
assumptions.impact: Layer topology is self-checked; concept quantities (e.g., building density, concept floor area) are low-confidence design quantities, not statutory values.

assumptions.statement: All events, community operations, scenario opening, branding, investment attraction, and policy mechanisms are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: No activity, investment, or policy is presented as a confirmed government arrangement or implementation commitment.
